import pathlib,re,html,hashlib,json,sys
b=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
results={}
for name,pattern in [('itch-pricing',r'free|minimum|pay.what|donat'),('itch-creator-payments',r'Canada|Minimum Balance|minimum of 7 days|tax interview'),('itch-quality-guidelines',r'generative AI|software, or other')]:
 p=b/'raw'/(name+'.html')
 raw=p.read_bytes()
 plain=html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',raw.decode()))
 plain=' '.join(plain.split())
 results[name]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'excerpts':[plain[max(m.start()-55,0):m.end()+110] for m in list(re.finditer(pattern,plain,re.I))[:18]]}
live=(b/'raw/sqlite-live-local-readme.md').read_bytes()
results['live_readme_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(live).hexdigest()
(b/'itch-checkout-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v['excerpts'][:8] for k,v in results.items() if isinstance(v,dict)},ensure_ascii=False))
